scope: Opt-in since working-tree acquisition path and repository-marker identity
bug: Late Stat after Lstat boundary checks could observe a substituted file or parent; subsequent fstat then matched the replacement rather than the initial path observation. Git marker changes were not tracked across selected items.

fix.initial_leaf_identity: Lstat file identity used directly for regular non-alias paths
checkpoints: compare repeated observations across selected files
validate recorded path identities immediately after open
validate again after read before emission
fix.stored_in_memory: file identities and paths only, no new persistent state

deterministic_regression.previous_gate_replayed: Tests repeat former late Stat -> open -> fstat acceptance after each mutation; this is a source-level replay, not an instrumented old CLI run
additional_checks: new marker on later observation rejected
metadata count and path-byte budgets enforced
